fleet.verdict: T12 runtime fleet is DEAD — 0 of 12 live. No agent is currently doing runtime work to be validated, and none is available to validate a peer.

schemes.note: REAL zk proofs, 100% attested on-chain via EAS, current to yesterday. This is the scheme a validation verdict may cite.
STUB proofs from the pre-June migration, flagged is_real=false, 0% attested. MUST NOT back any verdict. Their existence is why a validator checks is_real, not row count.

zkRepID_integrity.verdict: The integrity view cleanly separates 22,356 real EAS-attested plonky3 proofs from 56,823 flagged stubs. The discriminator (is_real + eas_attested_pct) is the invariant a zk-backed verdict must honour.

zkRepID_pipeline.verdict: The pipeline is REAL but STALLED: 40,300 items pending, frozen 32 days; only 117 of 79,179 proofs are traceable to a generating job. New proof throughput is ~117 in 30 days. So the zk-backing mechanism exists and is attested, but is not flowing — a precondition to a LIVE zk-backed loop that currently fails.
